page.overview:
Who is Ringo?

is a raccoon played by Liam O'Brien for .

Ringo is a surly-faced raccoon with gray and black fur; the fur on his face has been fluffed to appear curly and the hair on his head has been slicked back. He wears a (comically) detached collar with a blue tie as well as purple, thick-framed glasses.

Ringo entered street racing so that he could get revenge on his cousin Scrapps' death.

Ringo eventually ends up killing Roadkill (controlled by Big Paulie, Medium Paulie, and Slightly Shorter Paulie) with the assistance of Reggie Burns and Vin Diesel.
